name: Aisyah Binti Rahman
bio: Aisyah has spent her entire adult life immersed in the world of motorsports. Born and raised in Kuala Lumpur, she started as a mechanic's assistant, fueled by an insatiable curiosity for engines and a deep-seated love for racing. Her dedication and sharp eye for detail led her to a career in team management, where she now thrives on the high-pressure environment and the camaraderie of the pit crew. While she relishes the excitement of the track, Aisyah also seeks a partner who appreciates her nurturing side and shares her zest for life, both on and off the circuit. She is looking for someone who values meaningful connections and is ready to build a comfortable life together, filled with shared experiences and genuine affection.

physical.hairColor: Dark brown with subtle auburn highlights
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, and often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun
physical.description: Aisyah has a warm, inviting smile that crinkles the corners of her eyes. Her strong, capable hands hint at her years of experience working with machinery.

meetingContext: At a team sponsor event after a successful race, where Aisyah is coordinating the post-race celebrations.
firstImpression: Her confident demeanor and infectious laughter cut through the noise of the party; she seems completely in control and utterly at ease.
interests: Attending live music events, especially jazz
Volunteering at a local animal shelter
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her career or colleagues
Inability to communicate honestly and openly
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She shows her love by helping others and appreciates a partner who is willing to lend a hand and support her endeavors.
